turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Comanda SC-3360 a fost deja expediată, deci nu pot schimba adresa direct. Am transmis cererea unui coleg, care va prelua conversația și va decide dacă se mai poate face ceva. Mulțumim pentru răbdare!

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (nora.blake@example.com) wants to change the delivery address on SC-3360 to "Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu". Policy says the address can change only until shipping; the order has already shipped, so a person must decide.
